customer_question: Hi, we're on the Pro plan and I'm trying to invite a new analyst, but the Invite button says all seats are in use. There are 5 of us already. How do I add her without anyone losing their work? Thanks, Hannah
resolution: The Pro plan includes 5 seats, and all 5 seats were already occupied. The customer was given two options: remove a member who no longer needs access (Settings → Members in version 3.x, or Admin → Members in version 4.x), which keeps their workflows in the workspace, or upgrade to the Business plan, which includes 25 seats and takes effect immediately with prorated billing. The customer removed a former contractor and successfully invited the new analyst.
